use_case: AI estimating and bid assistant (individual subscription): quantity takeoff from uploaded drawings, unit price suggestions, and proposal letter drafting
vendor_or_model: AI estimating SaaS vendor (computer vision takeoff plus a generative language model); individual plan terms
data_categories: Drawings and specifications (FCI for FC-1 change orders; private clients' drawings); the owner's past bid prices; subcontractor quotes
consequential_decision_category: None (business decisions about bids and prices)
human_in_the_loop: Owner checks every quantity against the drawings and every price against subcontractor quotes before a bid goes out; the tool never submits anything
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) when FCI is uploaded; DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2) once the DoD subcontract is signed; client contract confidentiality clauses; FTC Act Section 5 applies to the vendor's own claims
status: Approved with conditions (no FCI or client drawings until business terms bar training; deletion of FC-1 uploads requested)
